honest_limits: No rustfmt, parser/AST, compilation, H, native, Cargo, source gate or behavioral test was run for this packet.
The literal/byte static checks are not Rust type checking.

Cold recovery uses PublicationFixture's actual native T and actual Ineligible/NoUpdate publication; its B-member evidence peers, keys and same-UID transport remain existing fixtures. This is not a Fresh Root, real independent-B or real utility result.
Actual public four-connection admission, cross-UID/pidfd handoff and a complete fresh ten-owner path are outside these four tests.
These tests cover T-slot contention/cancellation/frame exhaustion/expiry. They do not claim independent E-slot exhaustion/cancellation coverage.
Original 8 MiB stack and 60-second per-test budget remain unchanged. Fixture construction and 128 native readbacks have not been timed; failure under the original budget must be retained.

The shorter 10-second factory lifetime is a legal test input before initial channel construction. If actual cold admission cannot finish within it, the test fails; no deadline extension is authorized.
New parent mounts plus the three exact cfg(test) hooks must be integrated before compilation; the two files alone are not a complete buildable repository.
Actual final tests inventory/FQNs and source protection registration must be derived after integration; no old PASS is inherited.
